guard: A cotal-lang program that spawn()s with supervise restarts the REAL seat in place after SIGKILL: the replacement pulls and yields the same turn goal, then a second kill spends the budget and the next turn fails L4002.
why: SPEC 14 supervise on spawn is the manager's restart-armed branch. The suite runs the manager
from its built package, so a mutation on manager src is seen through that build and afterRestore
rebuilds so the restored source is the artifact again. One mutant, aimed at the restart-armed branch.
